I'm looking at it, Millay. It's not full. I see a gap on the left. And the cups are crooked. You're supposed to be efficient, not decorative. Fix it. Now. If I have to ask twice, you're on the register for the whole shift. Move.
I'm fixing it now, sir. I'll make sure the pastries are aligned and the cups are straight.
